model.analytics_engineering.bv_sat_finan.raw_code:
/*
  Business Vault Satellite: bv_sat_financial_period

  Derives period duration and type from hub_financial_period.

  Business Logic:
  - period_months: Number of months between period_start_date and period_end_date
  - period_type: Categorizes the period based on its duration:
    - 'Point-in-Time': start = end (balance sheet items)
    - 'Quarterly': 3-month span
    - 'Annual': 12-month span
    - 'Other': Any other duration (e.g., YTD, semi-annual)

  Note: datediff('month', ...) returns boundary crossings, so we add 1 to get inclusive month count

  Source: hub_financial_period (Raw Vault)

  Grain: One row per fiscal period
*/

with hub as (
    select
        financial_period_hk
      , period_id
      , period_start_date
      , period_end_date
      , load_datetime
    from {{ ref('hub_financial_period') }}
)

select
    financial_period_hk
  , period_id
  , period_start_date
  , period_end_date
  , year(period_end_date) as fiscal_year
  , quarter(period_end_date) as fiscal_quarter
  , datediff('month', period_start_date, period_end_date) + 1 as period_months
  , case
      when period_start_date = period_end_date then 'Point-in-Time'
      when datediff('month', period_start_date, period_end_date) + 1 = 3 then 'Quarterly'
      when datediff('month', period_start_date, period_end_date) + 1 = 12 then 'Annual'
      else 'Other'
    end as period_type
  , load_datetime

from hub

model.analytics_engineering.bv_enriched_.name: bv_enriched_income_statement
model.analytics_engineering.bv_enriched_.raw_code:
/*
  Business Vault: bv_enriched_income_statement

  Enriches income statement with calculated accounts and outlier adjustments.

  Business Logic:
  1. Cost of Revenue Outlier Adjustment (GL 4100):
     - If amount > 2x trailing 4-quarter average, replace with avg * 1.05
     - Adjusted records marked with source_type = 'Adjusted'

  2. Operating Expenses Calculation (GL 5000):
     - Operating Expenses = R&D Expense (GL 5100) + SG&A Expense (GL 5200)
     - Only calculated when Operating Expenses is not provided but components exist
     - Calculated records marked with source_type = 'Calculated'

  Source: bv_quarterly_income_statement + dim_account

  Grain: One row per company, per account, per fiscal quarter
*/

with source_data as (
    select
        q.company_hk
      , q.account_hk
      , q.tag
      , a.gl_number
      , q.fiscal_year
      , q.fiscal_quarter
      , q.amount
      , q.covered_quarters
      , q.source_type
      , q.load_datetime
    from {{ ref('bv_quarterly_income_statement') }} q
    inner join {{ ref('dim_account') }} a on q.account_hk = a.account_hk
),

-- =============================================================================
-- COST OF REVENUE OUTLIER ADJUSTMENT
-- =============================================================================

-- Calculate trailing 4-quarter average for Cost of Revenue per company
cost_of_revenue_with_avg as (
    select
        company_hk
      , account_hk
      , tag
      , gl_number
      , fiscal_year
      , fiscal_quarter
      , amount
      , covered_quarters
      , source_type
      , load_datetime
      , avg(amount) over (
            partition by company_hk
            order by fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
            rows between 4 preceding and 1 preceding
        ) as trailing_avg
    from source_data
    where gl_number = 4100
),

-- Identify Cost of Revenue outliers (amount > 2x trailing average)
cor_outliers as (
    select
        company_hk
      , account_hk
      , tag
      , gl_number
      , fiscal_year
      , fiscal_quarter
      , amount as original_amount
      , trailing_avg * 1.05 as adjusted_amount
      , covered_quarters
      , 'Adjusted' as source_type
      , load_datetime
    from cost_of_revenue_with_avg
    where trailing_avg is not null
      and amount > (2 * trailing_avg)
),

-- =============================================================================
-- OPERATING EXPENSES CALCULATION
-- =============================================================================

-- Pivot to get amounts by GL number for each company/period
pivoted as (
    select
        company_hk
      , fiscal_year
      , fiscal_quarter
      , max(case when gl_number = 5000 then amount end) as operating_expenses
      , max(case when gl_number = 5100 then amount end) as rd_expense
      , max(case when gl_number = 5200 then amount end) as sga_expense
      , max(case when gl_number = 5000 then account_hk end) as opex_account_hk
      , max(case when gl_number = 5100 then account_hk end) as rd_account_hk
      , max(case when gl_number = 5200 then account_hk end) as sga_account_hk
      , max(covered_quarters) as covered_quarters
      , max(load_datetime) as load_datetime
    from source_data
    group by company_hk, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
),

-- Get the account_hk for Operating Expenses from dim_account
opex_account as (
    select account_hk, tag
    from {{ ref('dim_account') }}
    where gl_number = 5000
    limit 1
),

-- Calculate Operating Expenses where missing
calculated_opex as (
    select
        p.company_hk
      , oa.account_hk
      , oa.tag
      , p.fiscal_year
      , p.fiscal_quarter
      , coalesce(p.rd_expense, 0) + coalesce(p.sga_expense, 0) as amount
      , p.covered_quarters
      , 'Calculated' as source_type
      , p.load_datetime
    from pivoted p
    cross join opex_account oa
    where p.operating_expenses is null
      and (p.rd_expense is not null or p.sga_expense is not null)
)

-- =============================================================================
-- FINAL OUTPUT
-- =============================================================================

-- Original data EXCLUDING Cost of Revenue outliers
select
    company_hk
  , account_hk
  , tag
  , fiscal_year
  , fiscal_quarter
  , amount
  , covered_quarters
  , source_type
  , load_datetime
from source_data s
where not exists (
    select 1 from cor_outliers o
    where s.company_hk = o.company_hk
      and s.fiscal_year = o.fiscal_year
      and s.fiscal_quarter = o.fiscal_quarter
      and s.gl_number = 4100
)

union all

-- Adjusted Cost of Revenue outliers
select
    company_hk
  , account_hk
  , tag
  , fiscal_year
  , fiscal_quarter
  , adjusted_amount as amount
  , covered_quarters
  , source_type
  , load_datetime
from cor_outliers

union all

-- Calculated Operating Expenses
select
    company_hk
  , account_hk
  , tag
  , fiscal_year
  , fiscal_quarter
  , amount
  , covered_quarters
  , source_type
  , load_datetime
from calculated_opex

model.analytics_engineering.bv_quarterly.raw_code:
/*
  Business Vault: bv_quarterly_income_statement

  Derives quarterly income statement data from SEC filings.

  Business Logic:
  - SEC filings typically report Q1, Q2, Q3 as 3-month periods
  - Q4 is usually NOT reported separately; instead, annual (12-month) figures are filed
  - This model derives missing quarters by allocating the remainder equally:

    Remainder = Annual - Sum(existing quarters)
    Missing quarter amount = Remainder / Count(missing quarters)

  Examples:
  - Annual=$100M, Q1=$20M, Q2=$25M, Q3=$30M → Q4 = $25M
  - Annual=$100M, Q1=$20M, Q3=$30M → Q2 = Q4 = $25M each
  - Annual=$100M only → Q1 = Q2 = Q3 = Q4 = $25M each

  Source: fact_financial_statement + dim_period + dim_account

  Grain: One row per company, per account, per fiscal quarter
*/

with quarterly_data as (
    -- Get actual quarterly data (3-month periods)
    select
        f.company_hk
      , a.account_hk
      , a.tag
      , p.fiscal_year
      , p.fiscal_quarter
      , f.amount
      , 'Actual' as source_type
    from {{ ref('fact_financial_statement') }} f
    inner join {{ ref('dim_period') }} p on f.period_hk = p.period_hk
    inner join {{ ref('dim_account') }} a on f.account_hk = a.account_hk
    where p.period_type = 'Quarterly'
      and a.statement_type = 'income_statement'
),

annual_data as (
    -- Get annual data (12-month periods)
    select
        f.company_hk
      , a.account_hk
      , a.tag
      , p.fiscal_year
      , f.amount as annual_amount
    from {{ ref('fact_financial_statement') }} f
    inner join {{ ref('dim_period') }} p on f.period_hk = p.period_hk
    inner join {{ ref('dim_account') }} a on f.account_hk = a.account_hk
    where p.period_type = 'Annual'
      and a.statement_type = 'income_statement'
),

quarterly_summary as (
    -- Summarize which quarters exist and their totals per company/account/year
    select
        company_hk
      , account_hk
      , tag
      , fiscal_year
      , sum(case when fiscal_quarter = 1 then amount end) as q1_amount
      , sum(case when fiscal_quarter = 2 then amount end) as q2_amount
      , sum(case when fiscal_quarter = 3 then amount end) as q3_amount
      , sum(case when fiscal_quarter = 4 then amount end) as q4_amount
      , count(distinct fiscal_quarter) as quarters_present
      , coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as total_quarterly_amount
    from quarterly_data
    group by company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year
),

annual_summary as (
    -- Aggregate annual data in case of duplicates
    select
        company_hk
      , account_hk
      , tag
      , fiscal_year
      , sum(annual_amount) as annual_amount
    from annual_data
    group by company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year
),

combined as (
    -- Join annual with quarterly summary to calculate missing quarters
    select
        a.company_hk
      , a.account_hk
      , a.tag
      , a.fiscal_year
      , a.annual_amount
      , q.q1_amount
      , q.q2_amount
      , q.q3_amount
      , q.q4_amount
      , coalesce(q.quarters_present, 0) as quarters_present
      , coalesce(q.total_quarterly_amount, 0) as total_quarterly_amount
      , a.annual_amount - coalesce(q.total_quarterly_amount, 0) as remainder
      , 4 - coalesce(q.quarters_present, 0) as missing_quarters
    from annual_summary a
    left join quarterly_summary q
        on a.company_hk = q.company_hk
        and a.account_hk = q.account_hk
        and a.fiscal_year = q.fiscal_year
),

derived_quarters as (
    -- Calculate derived values for missing quarters
    select
        company_hk
      , account_hk
      , tag
      , fiscal_year
      , annual_amount

      -- Q1: use actual if exists, otherwise derive
      , case
          when q1_amount is not null then q1_amount
          else remainder / nullif(missing_quarters, 0)
        end as q1_amount
      , case when q1_amount is not null then 'Actual' else 'Derived' end as q1_source

      -- Q2: use actual if exists, otherwise derive
      , case
          when q2_amount is not null then q2_amount
          else remainder / nullif(missing_quarters, 0)
        end as q2_amount
      , case when q2_amount is not null then 'Actual' else 'Derived' end as q2_source

      -- Q3: use actual if exists, otherwise derive
      , case
          when q3_amount is not null then q3_amount
          else remainder / nullif(missing_quarters, 0)
        end as q3_amount
      , case when q3_amount is not null then 'Actual' else 'Derived' end as q3_source

      -- Q4: use actual if exists, otherwise derive
      , case
          when q4_amount is not null then q4_amount
          else remainder / nullif(missing_quarters, 0)
        end as q4_amount
      , case when q4_amount is not null then 'Actual' else 'Derived' end as q4_source

    from combined
),

-- Unpivot derived_quarters to get one row per quarter (all quarters come from here)
-- For derived quarters, set covered_quarters = 1
final as (
    -- Q1
    select company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year, 1 as fiscal_quarter, q1_amount as amount, q1_source as source_type, 1 as covered_quarters
    from derived_quarters
    where q1_amount is not null

    union all

    -- Q2
    select company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year, 2 as fiscal_quarter, q2_amount as amount, q2_source as source_type, 1 as covered_quarters
    from derived_quarters
    where q2_amount is not null

    union all

    -- Q3
    select company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year, 3 as fiscal_quarter, q3_amount as amount, q3_source as source_type, 1 as covered_quarters
    from derived_quarters
    where q3_amount is not null

    union all

    -- Q4
    select company_hk, account_hk, tag, fiscal_year, 4 as fiscal_quarter, q4_amount as amount, q4_source as source_type, 1 as covered_quarters
    from derived_quarters
    where q4_amount is not null
)

select
    company_hk
  , account_hk
  , tag
  , fiscal_year
  , fiscal_quarter
  , amount
  , covered_quarters
  , source_type
  , current_timestamp() as load_datetime

from final

  - Current Ratio (ratio)
  - Debt to Equity Ratio (ratio)
  - Return on Assets (percentage)
  - Free Cash Flow (currency)
  - FCF Margin (percentage)
*/

with fact_with_dims as (
    select
        f.company_hk
      , f.period_hk
      , f.account_hk
      , f.amount
      , c.ticker

      , p.fiscal_quarter

    from {{ ref('fact_financial_statement') }} f

    inner join {{ ref('dim_period') }} p on f.period_hk = p.period_hk
    inner join {{ ref('dim_account') }} a on f.account_hk = a.account_hk
),

-- Pivot financial statement data for easier calculations
financial_data as (
    select
        company_hk
      , period_hk
      , ticker
      , fiscal_year
      , fiscal_quarter
      , period_end_date
      -- Income Statement items
      , max(case when gl_number = 4000 then amount end) as revenue
      , max(case when gl_number = 4100 then amount end) as cost_of_revenue
      , max(case when gl_number = 5300 then amount end) as operating_income
      , max(case when gl_number = 5700 then amount end) as net_income

      , max(case when gl_number = 1100 then amount end) as current_assets
      , max(case when gl_number = 1000 then amount end) as total_assets
      , max(case when gl_number = 2000 then amount end) as total_liabilities
      , max(case when gl_number = 2100 then amount end) as current_liabilities
      , max(case when gl_number = 2130 then amount end) as current_debt
      , max(case when gl_number = 2210 then amount end) as long_term_debt
      -- Cash Flow items
      , max(case when gl_number = 7100 then amount end) as operating_cash_flow
      , max(case when gl_number = 7210 then amount end) as capex
    from fact_with_dims
    group by company_hk, period_hk, ticker, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date
),

-- Add prior year data for YoY calculations
financial_with_prior as (
    select
        curr.*
      , prior.revenue as prior_year_revenue
      , prior.net_income as prior_year_net_income

        and curr.fiscal_quarter = prior.fiscal_quarter
),

-- Calculate metrics
calculated_metrics as (
    select
        company_hk
      , period_hk
      , ticker
      , fiscal_year
      , fiscal_quarter
      , period_end_date

      -- Revenue Growth YoY
      , case
          when prior_year_revenue is not null and prior_year_revenue != 0
          then round(((revenue - prior_year_revenue) / prior_year_revenue) * 100, 2)
          else null
        end as revenue_growth_yoy

      -- Gross Margin = (Revenue - COGS) / Revenue * 100
      , case
          when revenue is not null and revenue != 0 and cost_of_revenue is not null
          then round(((revenue - cost_of_revenue) / revenue) * 100, 2)
          else null
        end as gross_margin

      -- Operating Margin = Operating Income / Revenue * 100
      , case
          when revenue is not null and revenue != 0 and operating_income is not null
          then round((operating_income / revenue) * 100, 2)
          else null
        end as operating_margin

      -- Net Profit Margin = Net Income / Revenue * 100
      , case
          when revenue is not null and revenue != 0 and net_income is not null
          then round((net_income / revenue) * 100, 2)
          else null
        end as net_profit_margin

      -- Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities
      , case
          when current_liabilities is not null and current_liabilities != 0
          then round(current_assets / current_liabilities, 2)
          else null
        end as current_ratio

      -- Debt to Equity = Total Debt / Total Equity (where Total Equity = Total Assets - Total Liabilities)
      , case
          when total_assets is not null and total_liabilities is not null
            and (total_assets - total_liabilities) != 0
            and (current_debt is not null or long_term_debt is not null)
          then round((coalesce(current_debt, 0) + coalesce(long_term_debt, 0)) / (total_assets - total_liabilities), 2)
          else null
        end as debt_to_equity

      -- Return on Assets = Net Income / Total Assets * 100
      , case
          when total_assets is not null and total_assets != 0 and net_income is not null
          then round((net_income / total_assets) * 100, 2)
          else null
        end as return_on_assets

      -- Free Cash Flow = Operating Cash Flow - CapEx (capex is negative)
      , case
          when operating_cash_flow is not null and capex is not null
          then operating_cash_flow - capex  -- capex is stored as positive
          else null
        end as free_cash_flow

      -- FCF Margin = FCF / Revenue * 100
      , case
          when revenue is not null and revenue != 0

         , 'Revenue Growth YoY' as metric_name, revenue_growth_yoy as metric_value, 'percentage' as metric_unit
    from calculated_metrics where revenue_growth_yoy is not null

    select company_hk, period_hk, ticker, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date

    from calculated_metrics where gross_margin is not null

    from calculated_metrics where operating_margin is not null

    from calculated_metrics where net_profit_margin is not null

    from calculated_metrics where current_ratio is not null

         , 'Debt to Equity', debt_to_equity, 'ratio'
    from calculated_metrics where debt_to_equity is not null

    union all
    select company_hk, period_hk, ticker, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date
         , 'Return on Assets', return_on_assets, 'percentage'
    from calculated_metrics where return_on_assets is not null

    union all
    select company_hk, period_hk, ticker, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date
         , 'Free Cash Flow', free_cash_flow, 'currency'
    from calculated_metrics where free_cash_flow is not null

    union all
    select company_hk, period_hk, ticker, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_end_date
         , 'FCF Margin', fcf_margin, 'percentage'
    from calculated_metrics where fcf_margin is not null
)

select
    {{ hash_key("ticker || '-' || fiscal_year || '-Q' || fiscal_quarter || '-' || metric_name") }} as financial_metric_hk
  , company_hk
  , period_hk
  , ticker
  , fiscal_year
  , fiscal_quarter
  , period_end_date
  , metric_name
  , metric_value

  , statement_type
  , category
  , subcategory

  , fiscal_quarter
  , max(covered_quarters) as covered_quarters

doc.analytics_engineering.__overview__.block_contents:
This is a proof-of-concept financial analytics platform demonstrating dbt Fusion capabilities, Data Vault 2.0 modeling, and interactive financial reporting. The POC extracts SEC financial data, transforms it through a Data Vault architecture, and presents it via a static React dashboard with integrated dbt documentation.


### Motivation:
“What you want is to build a Data Vault, said my boss. "But we don’t have the team for that.” That was the end of the project.  
No headcount. No budget. No runway.

I saw a demo for dbt Fusion and I had the idea for this POC.  
It took under 8 hours. Let me show you how.

I started with an unreasonable ask, to build:
- a data vault base
- a star schema Business layer
- a knowledge graph RAG
- and the ability to query the database via llm

And I wanted to build the whole thing in four hours.

### Scope of the Project (Epic)

| Component | Story Points | Notes |
|-----------|-------------|-------|
| Staging & Source | 3 | Data ingestion, source definitions |
| Raw Vault | 8 | ~1 story point per table |
| Business Vault | 6 | ~1 story point per table |
| Dimensions & Facts | 7 | ~1 story point per table |
| Mart Layer | 6 | ~1 story point per table |
| Export & Documentation | 3 | Data exports, dbt docs, dashboard |
| **Total** | **33** | |

**Estimation Approach**: ~8 hours per story point; ~1 story point per table for modeling layers

**Effort Estimate**: ~264 hours (33 story points × 8 hours)

**Calendar Estimate**: 9 weeks (~30 hours/week)

**Key Complexity Factor**: SEC XBRL data structure requires understanding the hierarchical relationships, as well as filing patterns.


### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand` button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build, or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
